caption:
A forecast is not money. It is a claim, and most tools never go back and check theirs.

Growth Terminal commits its number in advance, then grades that number against what actually landed.

→ growthterminal.io
first_comment: Worked, missed, or not enough evidence. Two of the three are not good news.
alt_text: Poster reading: You cannot spend a forecast. So we grade ours against the real number, after.
